sourceTitle: The Voyage Alone in the Yawl "Rob Roy"
description: "The Voyage Alone in the Yawl 'Rob Roy'" by John MacGregor is a travel memoir written in the late 19th century. The book chronicles the author's adventurous journey sailing solo in his yawl named Rob Roy, exploring the coasts of England, France, and a bit of the channel.
